title: Interview English
subtitle: Answer Confidently, Not Just Correctly
bestFor: Final-year students, recent graduates, job switchers
problem: You know the answer but nerves, grammar errors, or lack of structure make you sound unsure.
benefits: Structure your answers using proven frameworks (no mugging up)
Speak in confident, clear English even under pressure
Handle tricky questions like 'Tell me about yourself' and 'Why should we hire you?'
Control pace, tone, and pauses like a pro
Walk out of every interview feeling prepared, not lucky

subtitle: Be Heard in Meetings, Not Just Present
